ACT XLI OF 1997

CENSUS (AMENDMENT)
ACT, 1997
An Act further to
amend the
Census Ordinance,
1959
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I,
22nd December,
1997]
The following Act of
Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of the Acting President on the
15th December, 1997, is hereby published for general information:--
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Act may be called the Census (Amendment) Act, 1997.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 13, Ordinance X of 1959

The following Act of
Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of the Acting President on the
15th December, 1997, is hereby published for general information:--
2. Amendment of section 13,
Ordinance X of 1959.--In the Census Ordinance, 1959 (X of 1959), in section
13, for the words "one month" and "one thousand" the words
"six months" and "fifteen thousand" shall be substituted
respectively.
